messages:
Ana (PM): Quick sync — proposing rollout approach for smart-routing-v2. Goal: minimize latency regressions while testing model variants + new routing policy. Suggestion: 3-phase micro-cohort warmup + synthetic traffic + explicit fallback matrix. TL;DR: eu -> us -> global, A/B for quality, auto-fallback to v1 if SLOs break.
Lee (Eng): +1. Implementation notes: feature flag with phased percentages, a canary job that runs synthetic load and probes p95/p99 and error rate. We can reuse existing route-switcher service.
Jordan (SRE): Need concrete SLO gates. Proposal: p95 < 220ms, p99 < 420ms, 5xx < 0.5% for 30m window. Synthetic canary: 50rps for 15m per cohort. If any gate fails -> immediate rollback to v1 for that cohort + page. :rotating_light:
Maya (ML): Quality gating: run the prompt-set eval (10k samples) in shadow for A/B, do BLEU/embedding-sim thresholds and a focused hallucination check on top 200 customer prompts. If quality delta > 3% we block. Also suggest adding a fast drift check on embeddings for each cohort.
Tarun (Sales): Heads-up — two EU customers (Acme, Nebula) asked to be opt-in 100% earlier than plan. We should add an opt-in path and communicate guardrails. Also legal needs confirmation on EU routing before we expand.
Lee (Eng): Flag config draft (we can store in infra repo):
```
flag: smart-routing-v2
phases:
  - name: eu-micro
    pct: 2
    synthetic: true
    sla:
      p95: 220ms
      err_rate: 0.5%
  - name: eu-scale
    pct: 15
    synthetic: false
    sla:
      p95: 240ms
  - name: global-canary
    pct: 5
    ab_test: true
```
Jordan (SRE): Additions: telemetry contract must include per-flag p95/p99, error breakdown, model fallback count, and synthetic canary traces. Retention 7d for canary detail and 90d for rollouts. Also produce a runbook snippet for operators: how to force-fallback, metric dashboard links, and who to page.
Ana (PM): Good. Ops handoff: @Jordan can you own the runbook draft? @Lee assign the feature-flag PR and make an opt-in toggle for those customers.
Jordan (SRE): I'll draft runbook later today and add the dashboard panels. Will put in paging thresholds.
Lee (Eng): Will open PR and tag infra + qa. Need QA to run synthetic harness — @deploy-bot can you kick a synthetic job once PR is merged?
deploy-bot: Scheduled synthetic canary job will run after merge to main and report to #eng-oncall.
Maya (ML): One more: add an eval checkpoint after eu-micro for embeddings drift and leakage checks. If drift > 0.07 cosine, stop progression.
Tarun (Sales): I'll draft a short customer note template for opt-in cohort and legal check request.
Ana (PM): I'll consolidate these into a launch checklist and post to this thread by EOD. Include: flag PR, runbook link, synthetic job config, QA signoff, customer opt-in list, and telemetry contract. :white_check_mark:
Lee (Eng): Also adding a kill-switch: global featureflag-fallback: true -> routes everyone to v1 within 30s. We'll document in runbook.
Jordan (SRE): Agree. Final ask: test the rollback latency in staging (measure how long until KV cache drains and requests are routed). If > 45s we need a mitigation.
Ana (PM): Noted. Thanks everyone — next steps captured. Ping me for any blockers.
